negative_cases.name: one_page_6
negative_cases.scope: One fixed cyclic label order. All polygon triangulations, one omitted triangle, independently chosen attachment vertex and reflection in each retained triangle; only dihedral averaging.

negative_cases.name: ear_7
negative_cases.scope: N7 exterior-ear products from all D6 images of the eight exact N6 two-page product types, all three new-triangle attachment vertices and both reflections, then D7 averaging. Every graph retains two noncrossing pages. This is a restricted recurrence test, not the full two-page family.

negative_cases.name: translated_ear_7
negative_cases.scope: Whole exact N6 two-page cycle, translated by 0 or ±(e6−e0), ±(e6−e5), multiplied by any rooted/reflected exterior-ear triangle, then D7 averaged. A particular 30-state recurrence test only.
